description: Lists the services a budget can pay: each one's name, URL, price, chain and whether its output is sample data. With once, lists what Single purchase on superstables.com can buy instead. chain narrows the list to one chain, such as base-sepolia. A price is what the seller asked for last and may have changed. Reads a list and moves no funds.

chain.description: A chain key, such as "base-sepolia", "moderato" or "devnet"

once.description: True for the services Single purchase on superstables.com can buy, without a budget

name: find_budget_services
title: Find services a budget can pay
